source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of types of cloud services (PDF 156-157).

blocks.text: Cloud services teen bari qismon mein hain, Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS) aur Software as a Service (SaaS), har ek control, lachak aur intezam ka mukhtalif darja deti hai.

blocks.prompt: Cloud services ki qismein bata kar un ka muwazna kijiye (long question 3).
blocks.explanation: IaaS bunyadi infrastructure, virtual servers, storage aur networking, kiraye par deta hai aur user operating system aur us se oopar sab sambhalta hai (AWS, Azure, Google Compute Engine). PaaS platform, middleware, development tools aur intezam bhi deta hai, to developers sirf code likhte aur deploy karte hain (Google App Engine, Heroku). SaaS mukammal applications internet par deta hai, kuch sambhalna nahi (Gmail, Google Docs, Office 365, Salesforce). IaaS se SaaS ki taraf sahoolat barhti aur control ghatta hai.

items: IaaS: infrastructure; PaaS: platform; SaaS: software. Zyada sahoolat, kam control.
